independent_confirmation.what_it_is: CF.fit_arm at 255 leaves with CF.HOLD = () on the SHIPPED class -- H's own recipe refitted through the new path (lfpgrider.py:95-99)
independent_confirmation.reading: the refit reproduces H exactly off LFPG on every fold, so the two paths are identical in fact and LightGBM is reproducible here.  The refit the desk offered to have me run would return the same answer and is not run

reading.ratio_2A_over_B_is_the_whole_story: gain = 2A - B, so a read is positive exactly when 2A/B > 1.  That ratio is twice the regression coefficient of the residual on the increment: it says whether the increment is applied at an amplitude its own signal supports.
